title: EU-LAC Statement on Converging Digital Policy and Regulatory Frameworks for AI
executive_summary: On November 16, 2023, during the AI Alliance Assembly in Madrid, representatives from select EU and Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries reaffirmed their commitment to the EU-LAC Digital Alliance, aiming to reinforce and converge digital policy and regulatory frameworks on artificial intelligence (AI). The statement highlights the importance of exchanging best practices, fostering innovation across linguistic and cultural contexts, and aligning with ethical guidelines such as those from UNESCO. The group supports the development of regulatory sandboxes and regular dialogue to ensure AI regulation promotes innovation, human capital, and infrastructure while safeguarding human rights. A bi-regional investment package will support these initiatives, with flexibility to address local needs. The participating states commit to acting as forerunners in sharing regulatory experiences and supporting the responsible, inclusive, and trustworthy development of AI, particularly benefiting startups and SMEs.
characteristics: Promotes exchange of best practices and operational regulatory measures on AI, including governance mechanisms, among EU and LAC countries.
Supports convergence of digital policy and regulatory frameworks on AI, with regular dialogue to foster innovation, human capital, infrastructure, and respect for human rights.
Encourages development and use of regulatory sandboxes and accelerators to support innovative and trustworthy AI, especially for startups and SMEs.
Emphasizes inclusivity by fostering AI development across linguistic diversities, particularly in Spanish, Portuguese, and other official EU languages.
Recommends considering UNESCO’s ethical guidelines for responsible and inclusive AI, especially in Latin America and the Caribbean.
Provides for a bi-regional investment package, with allocation tailored to local contexts, needs, and opportunities.
practical_applications: The EU-LAC Digital Alliance has been established as a framework for human-centric digital cooperation, including the reinforcement and promotion of convergence of digital policy and regulatory frameworks, particularly in AI.

A bi-regional investment package exists for the implementation of the Digital Alliance, with states jointly defining the allocation of Digital Alliance investment for activities related to AI policy and regulatory convergence.

Participating states are actively exchanging best practices and sharing operational regulatory measures and guidelines on AI, including governance mechanisms for implementing and monitoring AI regulation.

Regular dialogue is being maintained among participating states to exchange information and promote convergence of digital policy and regulatory frameworks on AI, with a focus on fostering innovation, human capital, infrastructure, and the protection of human rights.

The EU Regulation on AI, which includes the creation of regulatory sandboxes for the development and testing of innovative AI systems under competent authority supervision, is being implemented and shared as a model within the Alliance.

States are fostering an environment for AI development across linguistic diversities, particularly in Spanish, Portuguese, and other official EU languages, to ensure inclusivity and innovation tailored to different communities.

States are considering the implementation of sandboxes for innovative and trustworthy AI, as well as accelerators, and are sharing good practices and lessons learned to support innovative startups and SMEs in creating trustworthy AI.

kpi_list.kpi_text: States will promote the exchange of best practices and sharing of operational regulatory measures and guidelines, including on the governance mechanisms set up to implement and monitor AI regulation.
kpi_list.metric_name: Exchange of Best Practices on AI Regulation
kpi_list.target_description: Promote exchange of best practices and sharing of operational regulatory measures and guidelines, including governance mechanisms for AI regulation
kpi_list.measurement_method: Documentation and reporting of best practice exchanges and shared guidelines
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States in the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

kpi_list.kpi_text: Foster an environment where AI development thrives across linguistic diversities, particularly in Spanish, Portuguese and other official languages of the EU, to ensure AI technologies cater to the unique needs and contexts of the different communities, fostering innovation and inclusivity on a linguistic level.
kpi_list.target_description: Foster AI development that supports linguistic diversity and inclusivity, especially in Spanish, Portuguese, and other official EU languages
kpi_list.measurement_method: Assessment of AI solutions' linguistic coverage and inclusivity
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States in the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

kpi_list.kpi_text: States may take into account the work on ethical guidelines outlined by UNESCO, particularly nations in Latin America and the Caribbean. These guidelines encompass a collective commitment to fostering responsible and inclusive AI practices.
kpi_list.metric_name: Adoption of UNESCO Ethical AI Guidelines
kpi_list.target_description: Consideration and potential adoption of UNESCO ethical guidelines for responsible and inclusive AI
kpi_list.measurement_method: Reference to UNESCO guidelines in national AI policies and practices
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States, especially in Latin America and the Caribbean

kpi_list.kpi_text: A bi-regional investment package exists for the implementation of the Digital Alliance.
kpi_list.metric_name: Bi-Regional Investment Package for Digital Alliance
kpi_list.target_description: Establish and maintain a bi-regional investment package to support Digital Alliance implementation
kpi_list.measurement_method: Existence and allocation of investment package

kpi_list.kpi_text: States will jointly define the form of Digital Alliance investment to be allocated for the purposes of this statement. Having under consideration local contexts and different needs and opportunities that States may have.
kpi_list.metric_name: Definition of Digital Alliance Investment Allocation
kpi_list.target_description: Jointly define and allocate Digital Alliance investment according to local contexts and needs
kpi_list.measurement_method: Agreement and documentation of investment allocation
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States in the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

kpi_list.kpi_text: Maintaining a regular dialogue to exchange information with a view to converging digital policy and regulatory frameworks on AI, while ensuring that innovation, human capital and infrastructure are fostered, and human rights are respected.
kpi_list.metric_name: Regular Dialogue on AI Policy Convergence
kpi_list.target_description: Maintain regular dialogue to exchange information and promote convergence of digital policy and regulatory frameworks on AI
kpi_list.measurement_method: Frequency and documentation of dialogue sessions and outcomes
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States in the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

kpi_list.kpi_text: Regular dialogue will encourage the development of AI regulation that fosters innovation, human capital and infrastructure while ensuring safety, and protects human rights. These states will consider the different paces and impacts that the development of AI has taken in each individual country.
kpi_list.target_description: Encourage development of AI regulation that fosters innovation, human capital, infrastructure, safety, and human rights
kpi_list.measurement_method: Review of new or updated AI regulations and their alignment with stated goals
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States in the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

kpi_list.kpi_text: Within these dialogues, States will have under their consideration the development of legislation and, as a possibility, sandboxes for innovative and trustworthy AI and accelerators, and to share good practices and lessons learnt in this respect, in particular to help innovative startups and SMEs to create trustworthy AI.
kpi_list.metric_name: Development of AI Legislation, Sandboxes, and Accelerators
kpi_list.target_description: Consider development of legislation, sandboxes, and accelerators for innovative and trustworthy AI, and share good practices to support startups and SMEs
kpi_list.measurement_method: Tracking of legislative developments, sandbox creation, and support programs for startups/SMEs
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Participating States in the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

kpi_list.kpi_text: The Regulation on AI also foresees the creation of regulatory sandboxes to enable development and testing of innovative AI systems in a controlled environment and under the supervision of competent authorities.
kpi_list.metric_name: Creation of Regulatory Sandboxes for AI
kpi_list.target_description: Create regulatory sandboxes for development and testing of innovative AI systems under supervision
kpi_list.timeframe: Upon entry into force of the Regulation on AI
kpi_list.measurement_method: Establishment and operation of regulatory sandboxes
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Competent authorities in EU Member States

kpi_list.kpi_text: Exchanging information and best practices should be considered a priority for the partners of the EU – LAC Digital Alliance with a view to reinforcing and converging digital policy and regulatory frameworks on AI.
kpi_list.metric_name: Priority of Information and Best Practice Exchange
kpi_list.target_description: Prioritize exchange of information and best practices to reinforce and converge digital policy and regulatory frameworks on AI
kpi_list.measurement_method: Frequency and quality of information and best practice exchanges
kpi_list.responsible_entity: Partners of the EU-LAC Digital Alliance

top_actors.name: EU-LAC Digital Alliance
top_actors.justification: The EU-LAC Digital Alliance is the central framework and main subject of the statement, driving the cooperation, convergence, and policy alignment on AI between the EU and LAC countries. It is repeatedly referenced as the platform for joint activities, investment, and dialogue, making it the most relevant actor.

top_actors.name: European Union
top_actors.justification: The European Union is a primary signatory and initiator of the Digital Alliance, provides the regulatory model (AI Regulation), and is a key driver of the policy and regulatory convergence discussed. The EU's institutions and member states are central to the initiatives and decisions outlined.

top_actors.name: Governments
top_actors.justification: National governments from both EU and LAC regions are the main participants and implementers of the statement's commitments. They are responsible for exchanging best practices, enacting regulations, and ensuring the convergence of digital policy frameworks on AI.

top_themes.name: Digital Policy
top_themes.justification: The central focus of the document is the reinforcement and convergence of digital policy frameworks, particularly in the context of AI. The statement repeatedly emphasizes the need for aligned digital policies across EU and LAC countries, dedicating significant content to policy exchange, best practices, and regulatory harmonization. This theme is directly tied to the main objectives and commitments outlined in the document.

top_themes.name: Artificial Intelligence
top_themes.justification: AI is the specific technological domain around which the entire statement is structured. The document discusses AI regulation, the impact of generative AI, regulatory sandboxes, and the need for trustworthy and innovative AI. The strategic importance of AI is highlighted through references to upcoming EU regulations and the need for bi-regional cooperation on AI governance.

top_themes.name: EU-LAC Digital Alliance
top_themes.justification: The EU-LAC Digital Alliance provides the institutional and cooperative framework for all the commitments and activities described. The document frames all actions—policy convergence, investment, dialogue, and best practice exchange—within the context of this alliance, making it a foundational theme for the document's strategic direction and implementation.
